goal: Expose per-peer message processing CPU load in getpeerinfo and netinfo
Help node operators detect resource-intensive peers and evaluate peer-scheduling policies
reviewability: Waiting on author to answer open objections from ajtowns and sipa
agreement: Support for peer CPU diagnostics and anti-DoS monitoring (jonatack, yuvicc, laanwj, mzumsande)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sipa, theStack, BrandonOdiwuor, 1440000bytes)
Unaddressed blocking objection: metric is not actionable or comparable between peers (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: belongs in experimental RPC with decaying averages, not getpeerinfo (sipa)
Objection: raw CPU load alone is useless without transaction acceptance context (rebroad)

why: P3 because exposes a diagnostic field to help operators detect DoS attacks or evaluate peer scheduling
Incremental monitoring addition that is deferrable
